basic_profile.bio: A 26-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, who recently dived into the world of mechanical keyboards. By day, I work as a junior IT support technician, and by night, I'm either fishing on the Texas coast or chatting with friends online. I enjoy tinkering with electronics and love the satisfaction of a perfectly tuned mechanical keyboard. I'm single, love the outdoors, and I'm usually online in the evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of mechanical keyboards, primarily acquired through online forums, YouTube videos, and personal experimentation. My IT background aids in grasping the technical aspects, but I'm still learning the intricacies of mods and customizations.
